prompt: i have a Next.js 15 app with the app router and i need to build an inventory of all my pages for test planning. i'm in a monorepo at /home/nyaptor/dev/my-app with apps/nextjs as my frontend. i need a script that walks the app directory and produces a json file with all routes, their source files, and placeholder action/view_access fields i can fill in manually. what's the right schema for this and can you produce the build script?

assertions.description: Provides TypeScript interfaces for ActionInventory, ViewAccess, and PageInventoryEntry
Build script strips (group) directories from routes
Build script writes JSON to a configurable output path
Explains how to wire into package.json and barrel-export PAGES
Output includes placeholder actions[] and view_access fields
